# MUNISA ABDUKARIMOVA

## Problem 1

```{r problem_1_data,include=FALSE}

#####DO NOT MODIFY THIS CHUNK
library(tidyverse)

Category<-c("Alpha","Beta","Zeta")
City<-c("Hong Kong","London","Nairobi")

my_dat<-expand_grid(Category,City)

set.seed(84684)

my_dat$Value<-sample(1:10,9,replace=T)
```

```{r problem_1_solution,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gganimate)
library(gifski)

Category <- c("Alpha", "Beta", "Zeta")
City <- c("Hong Kong", "London", "Nairobi")

my_dat <- expand_grid(Category, City)

set.seed(84684)
my_dat$Value <- sample(1:10, 9, replace = TRUE)

# Create animated plot
p <- ggplot(my_dat, aes(x = Category, y = Value, fill = City)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Animated Value by Category", y = "Value", x = "Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  transition_states(City, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) +
  labs(subtitle = 'City: {closest_state}')

# Animate and save gif
animate(p, renderer = gifski_renderer())



```

## Problem 2

```{r problem_2_data,include=FALSE}

#####DO NOT MODIFY THIS CHUNK

Response<-c("Energize","Amazing","Great")
set.seed(9819)
Energize<-tibble(Company=rep("Energize",100),Output=rnorm(100,50,20))
set.seed(9819)
Amazing<-tibble(Company=rep("Amazing",100),Output=rnorm(100,50,10))
set.seed(9819)
Great<-tibble(Company=rep("Great",100),Output=rnorm(100,40,5))

my_dat<-bind_rows(Energize,Amazing,Great)
```

```{r problem_2_solution,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

Response <- c("Energize", "Amazing", "Great")
set.seed(9819)
Energize <- tibble(Company = rep("Energize", 100), Output = rnorm(100, 50, 20))
set.seed(9819)
Amazing <- tibble(Company = rep("Amazing", 100), Output = rnorm(100, 50, 10))
set.seed(9819)
Great <- tibble(Company = rep("Great", 100), Output = rnorm(100, 40, 5))
my_dat <- bind_rows(Energize, Amazing, Great)

fig <- plot_ly(
  my_dat, 
  x = ~Company, 
  y = ~Output, 
  color = ~Company, 
  colors = c('green', 'red', 'blue'),
  type = "box"
) %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "Output"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Company"),
    boxmode = "group"
  )

fig


```

## Problem 3

```{r problem_3_data,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

library(plotly)

Category<-seq(from=1,to=10)
Time<-seq(from=1,to=10)

dat3<-expand_grid(Category,Time)

set.seed(78957)
dat3$Quantity<-runif(100,0,10)
```


```{r problem_3_solution,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

Category <- seq(from = 1, to = 10)
Time <- seq(from = 1, to = 10)

dat3 <- expand_grid(Category, Time)

set.seed(78957)
dat3$Quantity <- runif(100, 0, 10)

plot_ly(
  dat3,
  x = ~Category, y = ~Quantity,
  frame = ~Time,
  type = 'scatter',
  mode = 'markers',
  marker = list(size = 15, color = ~Category, colorscale = 'Viridis')
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Animated scatter: Category vs Quantity over Time",
    xaxis = list(title = "Category"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Quantity")
  )


```
